note.restart: If you still see ads, restart the browser.
note.off: Turn it on, and ad addresses stop opening in every program. The system will ask for an administrator’s permission.
fresh: Update the lists when the system starts
fresh.hint: At most once a day. The program starts for a moment without a window and exits.
allowed.title: Do not block
allowed.hint: A site opens together with its subdomains. One per line.
blocked.title: Block as well
blocked.hint: One address per line. Subdomains are listed separately.
youtube: Ads inside YouTube videos cannot be removed this way: they come from the same addresses as the videos. The browser extension removes them.
source.yoyo: Ad servers from all over the world, about 3,600 addresses
source.adaway: Ads and trackers in apps, about 6,500 addresses, license CC BY 3.0
source.ruadlist: Ads of the Russian-speaking web, about 1,900 addresses, license CC BY 3.0
source.listefr: Ads of the French-speaking web, about 5,500 addresses, license CC BY-SA 3.0
source.easylistchina: Ads of the Chinese-speaking web, about 5,600 addresses
source.stevenblack: A large combined list, about 76,000 addresses. Windows spends a lot of processor time on it
error.closed: The hosts file cannot be changed: {reason}. An antivirus may be protecting it.
error.refused: The administrator’s permission was not given.
error.broken: The adx0 section of the hosts file is damaged. The file was not changed.
error.encoded: The hosts file is saved in UTF-16, which the system cannot read. The file was not changed.
error.unverified: The hosts file was not written completely, so its previous contents were restored.
error.silent: The list was not updated: {url} does not answer. ({reason})
error.short: The list {title} was not updated: it has too few addresses ({count}).
error.empty: There is nothing to block: choose at least one list.
